editorial: Cambodia’s “winter” is more like a cool summer. This is our pick for moderate weather and clear temple views, with the trade-off of bigger crowds.
The peak-season footage we saw showed Angkor Wat in all its grandeur, beneath clear skies.
We visited in mid-August. Intermittent cloud cover softened the views, but we could get up close, take pictures and almost have Angkor Wat to ourselves in the afternoon.
The wet season worked well for our short trip, though clear skies are never guaranteed.
Our stay was also significantly cheaper outside peak season.
Our preference is for the cooler winter months or the quieter wet season. We’d skip the remaining months: muggy heat can take the joy out of a long day exploring temples.
